decisions.subject: Which pipeline to run for an open-ended 'make a video' request on a zero-key machine

options_considered.label: Animated Explainer (production)
options_considered.reason: Zero-key capable: Piper TTS + Remotion component scenes + free music; production stability

options_considered.label: Animation pipeline (production)
options_considered.reason: Also zero-key capable but suited to motion-graphics-first briefs; explainer fits an educational topic better

options_considered.label: Cinematic (production)
options_considered.rejected_because: 0/17 video generation providers configured — motion clips impossible; still-image fallback is forbidden for cinematic briefs

decisions.reason: Best-quality output achievable with only free/local tools; the topic (educational explainer) matches the pipeline's purpose exactly.

decisions.subject: Which of the 3 research-grounded concepts to produce

options_considered.label: The Sky Should Be Violet (myth_busting)
options_considered.reason: Strongest hook, fills the #1 underserved gap (violet paradox), maps onto free Remotion components

options_considered.label: The Fourth-Power Law (data_narrative)
options_considered.reason: Great stat-card material but weaker emotional hook; absorbed as a beat inside c1

options_considered.label: 52 Years to Answer (timeline)
options_considered.reason: Fresh angle but less punchy for 60s; better as a longer video

decisions.reason: Highest information-gap hook grounded in research; hybridized with c2's quantitative beat per proposal_packet.selected_concept.modifications.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for the final render (both Remotion and HyperFrames available — HARD RULE comparison)

options_considered.label: Remotion (React scene stack)
options_considered.reason: Fit: the concept's beats are exactly the stock React scene stack — hero_title, text_card, bar_chart, stat_card, comparison — plus word-level caption support. Tradeoff: stock components risk a 'seen it before' look.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: Fit: strong for kinetic typography and custom HTML motion. Tradeoff: this container's /dev/shm is 64MB (Chrome wants >=256MB) per hyperframes doctor — renders fall back to screenshot mode with real failure risk; and this brief is chart/stat-shaped, not typography-shaped.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.rejected_because: Would reduce a motion-graphics explainer to stills — violates the motion_required delivery promise

decisions.reason: The brief is a data_explainer whose scenes map 1:1 onto the Remotion component stack; HyperFrames carries a container-specific render-stability risk (/dev/shm 64MB) flagged by its own doctor. Both runtimes were presented in the user-facing summary per the HARD RULE; selection made autonomously because this is a cloud run with no interactive approval channel.

decisions.subject: Templated vs atelier composition authoring

options_considered.label: Templated (stock cut.type scenes)
options_considered.reason: Fast, reliable, $0; fits a demonstration run where the goal is a complete working deliverable

options_considered.label: Atelier (hand-authored bespoke composition)
options_considered.rejected_because: This is an unspecified demonstration request, not a hero/brand piece; atelier's extra iteration cost is not justified without a user brief to art-direct against

decisions.reason: Demonstration run with an open-ended brief — templated delivers a reliable, complete result; atelier is offered as the follow-up upgrade if the user wants a bespoke look.

options_considered.reason: Free, local, only configured provider (installed during preflight)

decisions.reason: Only available provider; quality tradeoff disclosed in proposal quality_tradeoffs.

decisions.subject: TTS sample gate handling (section s4) — voice/settings approval before batch generation

options_considered.reason: Autonomous cloud run with no interactive approval channel; sample duration 14.63s vs 15s target (-2.5%, within tolerance); $0.00 cost means no financial risk from batching
